workload: One 100000-character agent document paragraph of snake_case identifiers (user_id, order_id, config_path) with no successful emphasis spans.
notes: Each intraword underscore fails canOpenEmphasis, then the loop indexOf-scans the rest of the paragraph for `, **, __, ~~, *, _, and [. A 100KB identifier-heavy paragraph is quadratic (measured ~29ms at 50KB, ~114ms at 100KB, ~455ms at 200KB) and returns one text node. A single forward pass over delimiter positions would return the same nodes in linear time. workload: Twelve bash function_call/output pairs, each output a distinct 128KiB shell transcript, plus the seeding user message.
notes: Compaction calls this on every shrink step. Each call JSON.stringifies every history item, so a turn's tool transcripts are copied in full just to count UTF-16 code units; the return value is the integer 457460. The 12x128KiB size keeps that copy live until the call returns (~1.61MB heap delta) instead of letting a young-gen GC hide it. A counter that walks the same JSON text without retaining the string would return the same count.
